summary: Added Console.out to rich/console.py: out(*objects, sep=" ", end="\n", style=None). It joins str() of the objects with sep, appends end, applies an optional style via get_style, and writes through the buffer like line() does. No markup, emoji, highlighting, wrapping, or cropping. Added three tests to tests/test_console.py (test_out, test_out_no_markup, test_out_style) and a CHANGELOG.md entry under 9.0.0 Added. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified.
